Consent: Study Information and Consent     Please read the following information carefully before deciding whether to participate.     This study is conducted by Yuning Yao as part of a Master’s thesis project at Leiden University, under the supervision of Derya Soydaner. The purpose of this study is to examine how people judge the credibility of online news-style content when AI-generated predictions or explanations are provided.     If you agree to participate, you will first complete a short background questionnaire. You will then be redirected to a separate web-based task where you will read short news-style items, make credibility judgments, and rate your confidence.     Some items in the study may contain misleading or false information, and some AI-generated outputs may be incorrect. This is necessary for the research. After the task, you will see a debriefing page with further explanation and access to an item clarification section. The full study takes about 20 minutes.     Participation is voluntary. You may stop at any time before submitting your responses, without penalty or disadvantage.     This study involves minimal risk. Some participants may experience minor discomfort, confusion, or fatigue during the task.     Data collected during the study may include your background responses, credibility judgments, confidence ratings, and basic interaction data from the web-based task. These data will be used for research purposes only.     Your data will be treated confidentially and processed in anonymized or pseudonymized form, in accordance with applicable research and data protection requirements. No directly identifying personal information will be collected unless explicitly stated.     You may request withdrawal of your personal data within one month after participation. However, if your data have already been fully anonymized and can no longer be linked to you, removal may no longer be possible.     If you have questions about this study, you may contact: Yuning Yao: y.yao.7@umail.leidenuniv.nl Derya Soydaner: d.soydaner@liacs.leidenuniv.nl  If you have concerns about your rights as a research participant, you may contact the secretary of the Ethics Committee for Mathematics and Natural Sciences of Leiden University: ethicscommittee@science.leidenuniv.nl     By continuing, you confirm that: you are 18 years or older; you have read and understood the information above; you voluntarily agree to participate in this study.
